references.text: The instructions for making the tent covering of goat hair that was to cover the tabernacle, as well as the covering of ram skins and sea cow skins to be placed over it.
The execution of the instructions for making the tent covering and the coverings for the tabernacle, which are now being put in place.
The Lord's command to Moses to set up the tabernacle, which is now being carried out as the tent and its coverings are put in place.
The responsibility of the Gershonites to carry the tabernacle's tent coverings and coverings during the journey through the wilderness.
The completion of all the work on the tabernacle, done just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
Moses did everything exactly as the Lord had commanded him, a theme repeated throughout the setting up of the tabernacle.
Both are steps in the same consecration process and illustrate total obedience to God's specific instructions.
Complementary actions within the same consecration sequence; both confirm that God's detailed instructions were followed precisely.
A complementary part of the same consecration ritual; together they demonstrate complete obedience in setting up the entire sanctuary.
